title: SXB VPN
shortDescription: Access-code VPN client with profile management and data quota tracking
fullDescription:
SXB VPN is an Android VPN client that uses access codes and profiles supplied by your service operator.

ACTIVATE YOUR ACCESS
Enter your code to associate your device and retrieve available connections. Valid access and, depending on the service, an active plan are required. The app does not provide free Internet access or replace your Internet subscription.

MANAGE YOUR CONNECTION
Choose a profile, start or stop the VPN and view connection status. SXB VPN uses Android's VPN service (VpnService) to route traffic to the server in the selected profile. Android asks for your permission before establishing the tunnel.

VIEW YOUR PLAN
Check used and remaining data quota and the validity of access supplied by the service. Traffic volumes are synchronized with the backend for plan management. A saved configuration does not guarantee connectivity without a network or valid access.

CONFIGURATIONS AND SUPPORT
Imported or provisioned configurations are encrypted locally on Android. You can view service notifications and contact support in the app. Available functions depend on the profile, granted permissions and installed version.

PRIVACY
The service processes device and account identifiers, activation information, traffic volumes and session data. The API keeps technical logs, including IP addresses. Technical diagnostics and Google Firebase Cloud Messaging are integrated; read the explanations and choices in the app and the privacy policy. Removing a profile locally or signing out does not delete data already received by the service.

Performance and availability depend on your network, server and plan. SXB VPN does not guarantee absolute anonymity or improved speed.
